queries.sql: SELECT `t`.*, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(nominal_bayar) FROM spay_pembayaran WHERE tagihan_id = t.id AND status = 'verified'), 0) as total_terbayar, (t.nominal - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(nominal_bayar) FROM spay_pembayaran WHERE tagihan_id = t.id AND status = 'verified'), 0)) as sisa_tagihan, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spay_pembayaran WHERE tagihan_id = t.id AND status = 'pending') as pending_count, (SELECT status FROM spay_pembayaran WHERE tagihan_id = t.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) as last_status, (SELECT bukti_bayar FROM spay_pembayaran WHERE tagihan_id = t.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) as last_bukti FROM `spay_tagihan` `t` WHERE `t`.`orang_tua_id` = '4' ORDER BY `t`.`batas_bayar` ASC
